ranking.used_for: joint ranking only, after all 36 full-duration jobs and their endpoint evaluations complete
ranking.aggregation: absolute completed episodes / attempted episodes across three policy seeds and two banks; also each policy seed and per-level clears/deaths/timeouts
ranking.select: highest-ranked non-reference arm; retain reference in all reporting even if it ranks first
ranking.failure_policy: show failed seeds and resolve infrastructure failure within one retry/full reservation; if any seed remains incomplete do not declare complete ranking or confirmation readiness

confirmation.arms: selected non-reference arm and reference_512x4 with identical effective settings except fresh seeds
confirmation.freeze: freeze selected config before fresh training, then all six endpoint hashes before opening final banks
confirmation.decision: report absolute clear totals/fractions, every training seed, per-level coverage and deaths/timeouts; Codex chooses provisional retained recipe from observed absolute final performance and seed consistency without declaring competence or statistical significance; no old +30 threshold
